author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description: At Smithsonian's @airandspaceMuseum #Apollo curator Dr. Teasel Muir-Harmony shows #AdamSavage the APAS-75 (Androgynous Peripheral Assembly System) from the 1975 Apollo-Soyuz Test Project and explains why #androgynous is part of the docking module’s name. What do you think?
title: Meet an Androgynous Space Docking Module

author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam is a collector of, among many things, chairs; no two in his workshop are alike and each has a unique story. So it's about time for Adam to give a tour of the aircraft seats he's acquired over the years, including two he picked up during the production of Mythbusters. Let's take a closer look at the pilot's chair and ejection seat!

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
